summary.business_type: Publisher / affiliate content site (wine deals + wine club reviews, EN/US)
summary.method: hermes-seo plugin (45 skills): 10 specialist role audits in parallel over a 19-page crawl, evidence-verified; key claims re-checked by hand against live HTTP responses
top_findings: Internal link graph is two dead-end islands: all 9 club/guide spokes have zero contextual out-links, /deals/ links straight to merchants and never to a club review
No HSTS header and hashed assets revalidate on every visit (cache-control: max-age=0, must-revalidate)
/subscribed/ is indexable, orphaned and listed in the sitemap
Schema is Entity-blind: Organization has no sameAs/@id and uses an SVG favicon as logo; Article has no image
Search intent is under-served: no ranked 'best wine clubs' page, all six reviews open with a hedged 'Depends…' verdict
quick_wins: Template-level 'Related' links (reviews <-> guides) + a club block on /deals/
Meta descriptions trimmed to <160 chars via one helper in Layout
Deal links renamed 'Get this deal at WTSO →' (agent-usable link names)
llms.txt refreshed (it still lists 7 pages, one club review)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 19 canonicals = https://fknwine.com/<path>/ with trailing slash
Unique titles + descriptions; single-hop redirects (http→https, www→apex, no-slash→slash, legacy German URLs)
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff + Referrer-Policy on every response; valid cert (GTS WE1)
Real 404 status; HTTP/2 + Brotli; TTFB ≈ 0.11 s; one 13.6 KB render-blocking CSS, no framework JS

findings.title: HSTS missing
findings.description: curl -sSI https://fknwine.com/ returns nosniff + referrer-policy but no strict-transport-security; no public/_headers in the repo. VERIFIED BY HAND.
findings.recommendation: Add public/_headers with Strict-Transport-Security.

findings.title: No immutable caching on hashed assets
findings.description: /_astro/Layout.<hash>.css and the woff2 fonts return cache-control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate despite content-hashed filenames. VERIFIED BY HAND.
findings.recommendation: /_headers: max-age=31536000, immutable for /_astro/*.

findings.title: /subscribed/ indexable and in the sitemap
findings.description: Thank-you page returns 200, has a canonical and no robots meta, and is listed in sitemap-0.xml. VERIFIED BY HAND.
findings.recommendation: noindex + exclude from the sitemap.

findings.title: Sitemap has no lastmod
findings.description: <loc> only on all 19 URLs.
findings.recommendation: Emit real per-page dates from the content frontmatter (lastChecked / updated).

findings.title: Robots Sitemap: points at the child sitemap
findings.description: Declaration is sitemap-0.xml, not sitemap-index.xml.
findings.recommendation: Reference the index.

findings.title: 6 meta descriptions >160 chars, 3 titles >60
findings.description: Worst: /wine-clubs/wine-access/ desc 272; /guides/how-to-cancel-a-wine-club/ title 74. VERIFIED BY HAND.
findings.recommendation: Add a length-capping helper in Layout; shorten the long titles.

categories.name: Content Quality / E-E-A-T
what_works: ai_pattern_score 0, filler_score 0 — the voice is genuinely human
Exceptional disclosure, imprint and dating discipline ('checked <date>' everywhere)
Non-templated metadata, low site risk

findings.title: No named author or credentials (Expertise)
findings.description: /about/ names nobody; only /imprint/ names the legal owner. All Article JSON-LD author = Organization.
findings.recommendation: Decide the byline question (brand rule says 'FKN Wine', not Nimar) and add a real 'how we test' page.

findings.title: No first-hand experience signals (Experience)
findings.description: 'we have NOT tested' appears on 5 pages; every review fact is the club's own claim re-quoted.
findings.recommendation: Actually run one cancellation flow and publish it with screenshots.

findings.title: Thin hubs
findings.description: /guides/ is 196 words (thin-content flag); /deals/ 369, /about/ 376, home 506. Only reviews (666–1,052w) and guides (586–692w) are substantial.
findings.recommendation: Add comparison/methodology prose to the hubs.

findings.title: Almost no contextual internal linking
findings.description: Guides and reviews each have exactly 1 inbound (their hub) and no cross-links. Confirmed independently by the cluster role.
findings.recommendation: Related-links blocks (fixed in this pass).

findings.title: Rigid review template, reused sentences
findings.description: All 6 reviews share the identical H2 set; 'cancel anytime' on 13 pages.
findings.recommendation: Vary structure per review as the collection grows.

findings.title: Breadth gap
findings.description: Only 9 editorial pages; no 'best of' master comparison, no state-shipping guide, no retailer hubs.
findings.recommendation: Content wave 4.

findings.title: CONTENT_ROADMAP.md describes an old German supermarket blog
findings.description: The in-repo roadmap is unrelated to the live English site.
findings.recommendation: Delete or rewrite.

categories.name: On-Page / SXO
what_works: Above-the-fold answers on every review; check-dates everywhere
Honest-limitation disclosure is a genuine trust moat
The cancel guide is differentiated from first-party FAQ SERPs

findings.title: Hedged verdicts on all six reviews
findings.description: Every review opens with a 'Depends…' badge (Firstleaf 'Depends who you are', Wine Access 'Depends on your budget'), so the first scanned element reads as a non-answer on an 'is X worth it' SERP.
findings.recommendation: Make the verdict decisive while keeping the honesty (fixed in this pass).

findings.title: Dead-end guides
findings.description: The price-per-bottle guide compares six clubs and links to none of their reviews; the cancel guide likewise. Lost conversion at peak intent.
findings.recommendation: Link each table row / step to the matching review (fixed in this pass).

findings.title: No ranked 'Best Wine Clubs' page
findings.description: The comparison SERP is owned by ranked listicles; /wine-clubs/ is a flat unranked list with no 'best for' framing.
findings.recommendation: Add a ranked/'pick by situation' layer to the hub.

findings.title: Gift buyer persona unserved
findings.description: Persona scores: cautious joiner 85, deal hunter 84, gift buyer 59.
findings.recommendation: A gift page.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid, server-rendered JSON-LD on all 19 pages; plugin validator clean
Organization + WebSite everywhere; AboutPage on /about/; Article on the 9 editorial pages
Correctly omitted FAQPage (rich results retired) and Product/Review ratings (brand forbids invented ratings)

findings.title: Organization logo is an SVG favicon
findings.description: 'logo':'https://fknwine.com/favicon.svg' — Google wants a raster logo ≥112×112.
findings.recommendation: Serve a 512×512 PNG (fixed in this pass).

findings.title: No sameAs / no @id entity linking
findings.description: Organization has no sameAs despite linking x.com/FKNWine in nav, footer and about.
findings.recommendation: Add @id + sameAs + @graph (fixed in this pass).

findings.title: Article has no image
findings.description: Article = headline/description/url/dates/author/publisher only, though og-default.png exists.
findings.recommendation: Add image (fixed in this pass).

findings.title: publisher is an inline stub without logo
findings.description: No logo on the publisher node.
findings.recommendation: Reference the Organization @id.

findings.title: No CollectionPage/ItemList on the hubs; no BreadcrumbList site-wide
findings.description: The three hub pages carry only Organization+WebSite.
findings.recommendation: Breadcrumbs added in this pass; ItemList as next step.

findings.title: Organization emitted 3× per article page without @id
findings.description: Standalone + author + publisher, no @graph → duplicate-entity risk.
findings.recommendation: @graph with shared @id (fixed in this pass).

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: LCP 0.42 s (home) / 0.44 s (club review) cold, Slow-4G + 4× CPU — text LCP, no image dependency
CLS 0.00 throttled; 0 long tasks; 0 KB framework JS; DOM 115–174 elements
Cold throttled weight: home 9 req / 75.0 KB; HTML br 4,337 B; 0 tags site-wide
font-display: swap on 10/10 faces; only 2 latin subsets actually fetched

findings.title: Hashed assets revalidate every visit
findings.description: CSS + both fonts return 304 on repeat visits (see Technical).
findings.recommendation: immutable caching (fixed in this pass).

findings.title: No font preload
findings.description: preload_check score 50, preload_hints 0; fonts take 417–553 ms throttled.
findings.recommendation: Preload the 2 latin woff2.

findings.title: One render-blocking stylesheet
findings.description: 3.7 KB br external CSS.
findings.recommendation: build.inlineStylesheets: 'always'.

findings.title: No field data available
findings.description: PSI rate-limited (HTTP 429) and no CrUX API key — the 93 is a lab synthesis, not Lighthouse.
findings.recommendation: Wire a PSI/Google API key for field CWV.

categories.name: Visual / Mobile
what_works: Value proposition and both CTAs visible without scrolling on desktop and mobile
No contrast failures (off-white/dark 19.4:1, yellow/dark 13.7:1, white/red badge 5.8:1)
Zero page-level horizontal overflow on all 12 viewports (independently re-verified)

findings.title: Undersized tap targets
findings.description: Nav links 44–85×20px, footer 38–68×20px, product CTAs 143×41px, the nav 'X' 9×20px; 17/17 tappables undersized on /deals/ mobile.
findings.recommendation: Min 44px hit area (fixed in this pass).

findings.title: Bare-text 'X' as the X/Twitter nav icon
findings.description: DOM is X — reads as a close button. VERIFIED BY HAND.
findings.recommendation: Real SVG glyph (fixed in this pass).

findings.title: Wide table clipped on mobile with no scroll cue
findings.description: Table 447px inside a ~342px wrapper; the 4th column is cut with no fade/hint.
findings.recommendation: Add a scroll affordance; consider a stacked layout under 480px.

findings.title: Sub-14px labels widely used
findings.description: 11.2px eyebrow pills, 12px badges, 12.8px meta, 13.6px nav/footer (46 elements under 14px on /wine-clubs/ mobile).
findings.recommendation: Raise the smallest sizes to ≥13px, nav/footer to 14px.

categories.name: AI Search / Agentic readiness
what_works: Lighthouse Agentic Browsing 3/3 mobile and 3/3 desktop (local v13.5.0 run); Agent-UX heuristic 100/100; 0 hard P0 fails
Raw HTML == rendered DOM on /deals/ and /wine-clubs/ (text similarity 1.000) — fully server-rendered
agent-accessibility-tree passes all 33 axe rules; unknown URLs return real 404s
The 'checked <date>' pattern plus hard sourced numbers is genuinely quotable

findings.title: PerplexityBot blocked at root
findings.description: robots.txt: 'User-agent: PerplexityBot / Disallow: /'. PerplexityBot is a SEARCH crawler, so the site is removed from Perplexity answers, while llms.txt simultaneously invites LLMs and Content-Signal says search=yes. VERIFIED BY HAND.
findings.recommendation: Owner decision — align the policy (allow search/reference agents, keep training blocked).

findings.title: Five outbound deal links all named 'Get this deal →'
findings.description: wtso ×2, wine.com, firstleaf, winc — the merchant is only in an adjacent span, so an agent cannot tell the targets apart. VERIFIED BY HAND.
findings.recommendation: Unique, descriptive link names (fixed in this pass).

findings.title: Content-Signal only in the '*' group
findings.description: The named AI groups never read the signal, contradicting llms.txt.
findings.recommendation: Owner decision with the robots policy.

findings.title: Newsletter form not agent-usable
findings.description: beehiiv loader injects client-side: 0 forms/inputs/iframes in raw or rendered DOM (the <noscript> fallback link is present).
findings.recommendation: Keep the fallback; a native form is optional.

findings.title: llms.txt is stale
findings.description: Lists 7 pages and 1 of 6 club reviews, omitting the strongest asset (the price-per-bottle table). VERIFIED BY HAND.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate from the sitemap (fixed in this pass).

findings.title: Split brand entity
findings.description: Machine string 'FKN Wine' vs human 'F*CK NICE WINE'; not linked by sameAs/@id.
findings.recommendation: Entity linking (fixed in this pass).

categories.name: Sitemap / Information Architecture
what_works: Sitemap↔crawl parity 19 = 19; every sitemap URL returns 200 directly (no redirects, no slash variants)
Valid XML, no deprecated priority/changefreq, shallow URL depth (max 2), consistent trailing slashes
Global nav/footer reachability; hubs link to children and children link back

findings.title: /subscribed/ indexable, orphaned and in the sitemap
findings.description: Zero internal inbound links; no noindex mechanism exists in Layout.astro. VERIFIED BY HAND.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in this pass.

findings.title: No lastmod
findings.description: Bare sitemap() integration.
findings.recommendation: Next step.

findings.title: No sibling/related links between reviews and guides
findings.description: /deals/ links to zero club reviews.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in this pass.

categories.name: Topic Cluster / Internal Linking
what_works: Two clean hub edges exist: /wine-clubs/ → 6 reviews, /guides/ → 3 guides
Nav and footer make every page globally reachable

findings.title: Two dead-end islands plus a stranded deals page
findings.description: All 9 spokes are dead ends (0 contextual out-links beyond one breadcrumb); /subscribed/ is a true orphan; /deals/ is linked contextually only from home and routes straight out to firstleaf.com, winc.com, wine.com, wtso.com — leaking users and link equity off-site.
findings.recommendation: Mesh the islands (fixed in this pass).

findings.title: No pillar pages
findings.description: /wine-clubs/ and /guides/ are bare indexes; the price-per-bottle guide is the latent pillar of the guides cluster.
findings.recommendation: Add comparison/methodology prose to the hubs.

findings.title: Content gaps
findings.description: Ranked: (1) recurring dated 'best wine deals this month' round-up, (2) 'best wine club for [gifting/budget/beginners]' use-case hubs, (3) 'are wine clubs worth it / vs Costco', (4) intro-offer & promo-code comparison, (5) cancellation fees by club.
findings.recommendation: Content wave 4.
